title: juniperus coahuilensis subsp. arizonica
intro: Juniperus coahuilensis subsp. arizonica, commonly known as Arizona juniper, is a subspecies of evergreen tree in the cypress family, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Arizona juniper include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Arizona juniper include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
